title: Tens of millions of South Korean retail investors, the market's biggest buyers in 2026, were caught in this week's selloff, as Samsung and SK Hynix tumble (Song Jung-a/Financial Times)
summary: Song Jung-a / Financial Times: Tens of millions of South Korean retail investors, the market's biggest buyers in 2026, were caught in this week's selloff, as Samsung and SK Hynix tumble — Millions suffer ‘unprecedented’ losses after Samsung and SK Hynix stock tumbles — Song Mi-kyung pocketed a profit of about Won300mn …
contentText:
Song Jung-a / Financial Times :

Tens of millions of South Korean retail investors, the market's biggest buyers in 2026, were caught in this week's selloff, as Samsung and SK Hynix tumble   —  Millions suffer ‘unprecedented’ losses after Samsung and SK Hynix stock tumbles  —  Song Mi-kyung pocketed a profit of about Won300mn …
